name: ga4gh-wes skill
summary: Submit, monitor, inspect, and cancel workflow runs on a configured GA4GH Workflow Execution Service (WES) endpoint
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Workflow Execution Service (WES), shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-wes` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Submit, monitor, inspect, and cancel workflow runs on a configured GA4GH Workflow Execution Service (WES) endpoint. Use when the user wants to run a CWL or WDL workflow on a GA4GH-compliant execution service, asks about the status, logs, outputs, or tasks of submitted runs, wants to stop a running workflow, or needs to know which workflow types and engines an endpoint supports.
